Title: Hydroponic Nutrients for Vegetables: EC & pH by Crop
Description: Feed hydroponic vegetables a complete nutrient at pH 6.0. EC by crop: lettuce 1.2–1.8, spinach 1.8–2.3, tomato 2.0–4.0 mS/cm. Which crops share a tank. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
